## GO analysis for bulk RNA sequencing

This code is for performing Gene Ontology analysis given lists of differentially expressed genes from likelihood ratio test (LRT) of bulk RNA sequencing. 

```{r}
plots_dir <- "plots_lrt"

if (!dir.exists(plots_dir)) {
  dir.create(plots_dir)
} else {
  print("Directory already exists!")
}

tables_dir <- "tables_lrt"

if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {
  dir.create(tables_dir)
} else {
  print("Directory already exists!")
}
```

```{r read in data}
res <- read.csv("./tables_lrt/a2d1_LRT_results_sig.csv")
resSig <- res[order(res$padj), ][1:336, ]
#resSig <- subset(resSig, log2FoldChange < -log(1.25, 2) | log2FoldChange > log(1.25, 2))
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r GO biological process}
sig_up <- subset(resSig, log2FoldChange > 0)
sig_down <- subset(resSig, log2FoldChange < 0)

sig_up_genes <- sig_up$X
length(sig_up_genes)
sig_down_genes <- sig_down$X

length(sig_down_genes)
sig_diff_genes <- c(sig_up_genes, sig_down_genes)
```


## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r GO biological process}
sig_up <- subset(resSig, log2FoldChange > 0)
sig_down <- subset(resSig, log2FoldChange < 0)

sig_up_genes <- sig_up$X
length(sig_up_genes)
sig_down_genes <- sig_down$X

length(sig_down_genes)
sig_diff_genes <- c(sig_up_genes, sig_down_genes)
```


```{r GO biological process for differentially expressed (up + down)}
# Run GO enrichment using SYMBOL
go_bp <- enrichGO(
  gene = sig_diff_genes,
  OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType = "SYMBOL",
  universe = res$X,
  ont = "BP",
  readable = TRUE
)
head(go_bp)

library(enrichplot)
png("./plots_lrt/LRT_GO_BP.png", width=2000, height=2000, res=300)
  enrichplot::dotplot(go_bp, showCategory=15)
dev.off()


#save go output

write.csv(go_bp, file = "./tables_lrt/a2d1_genes_LRT_diff_GOBP.csv")
```

```{r GO biological process for upregulated genes}
# Run GO enrichment using SYMBOL
go_bp_up <- enrichGO(
  gene = sig_up_genes,
  OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType = "SYMBOL",
  universe = res$X,
  ont = "BP",
  readable = TRUE
)
head(go_bp_up)

library(enrichplot)
png("./plots/WTvKO_LRT_GO_BP_UP.png", width=2000, height=2000, res=300)
  enrichplot::dotplot(go_bp, showCategory=10)
dev.off()


#save go output

write.csv(go_bp_up, file = "./tables/a2d1_genes_LRT_up_GOBP.csv")
```


```{r GO biological process for downregulated genes}
# Run GO enrichment using SYMBOL
go_bp_down <- enrichGO(
  gene = sig_down_genes,
  OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType = "SYMBOL",
  universe = res$X,
  ont = "BP",
  readable = TRUE
)
head(go_bp_down)

library(enrichplot)
png("./plots/WTvKO_GO_BP_DOWN.png", width=2000, height=2000, res=300)
  enrichplot::dotplot(go_bp, showCategory=10)
dev.off()


#save go output

write.csv(go_bp_down, file = "./tables/a2d1_genes_down_GOBP.csv")
```

```{r}
#heatmap settings
myheatcol <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("lightblue","white", "orange"))(256)

dds_lrt <- readRDS("deseq_results_LRT_a2d1.rds")
vsd_lrt <- vst(dds_lrt, blind=FALSE)

df <- as.data.frame(colData(dds_lrt)) 
df <- df %>% arrange(Genotype)

# select nitrogen compound metabolic process genes
metab <- strsplit(go_bp_up[go_bp_up$Description == "nitrogen compound metabolic process",]$geneID, "/")[[1]]

toPlot_metab <- vsd[rownames(vsd_lrt) %in% metab,] 
toPlot_metab <- toPlot_metab[,rownames(df)]


#set quantile break points <https://slowkow.com/notes/pheatmap-tutorial/>
quantile_breaks <- function(xs, n = 100) {
  breaks <- quantile(xs, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n))
  breaks[!duplicated(breaks)]
}
toPlot_metab_breaks <- quantile_breaks(assay(toPlot_metab)[,1], n = 101)

mt <- toPlot_metab[rownames(toPlot_metab) %in% sig_diff_genes,]
# Labels to plot
    labels <- rownames(mt) 

    # Open a PNG device with a transparent background
ppi <- 300
png(file = "./plots_lrt/heatmap_metab_by_sample.png", width = 6*ppi, height = 6*ppi, res = ppi, bg = "transparent")

heatmap_metab <- pheatmap(assay(mt), 
                          cluster_rows=TRUE, 
                          cluster_cols=FALSE,
                          show_colnames = FALSE,
                          #show_rownames = FALSE,
                          annotation_col=df[c(2)], 
                          scale = "row", 
                          fontsize_row = 10, 
                          fontsize_col = 10, 
                          color = myheatcol,
                          #breaks = toPlot_metab_breaks, 
                          angle_col = 315, 
                          main = "Metabolic process genes", 
                          cellheight = 10, cellwidth = 10,
                          labels_row = labels, 
                          #cutree_rows = 2,
                          gaps_col = c(8, 16)
                          )

dev.off()
heatmap_metab

```
